verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a support inbox covering in-app, Slack, Discord and email conversations, and a feedback portal that centralizes insights through widgets and integrations. Nothing documents automatically extracting or capturing feedback from sales calls, support tickets, or chat conversations. These are adjacent features (a support inbox, generic integrations, AI-based de-cluttering of existing feedback), not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically capture customer feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, and chat conversations
